title.narrative: Initiating actions with the Global Methane Hub in Africa focusing on the waste sector

description.narrative: Following scope agreement via a concept note (attached), the Global Methane Hub (GMH) has invited GGGI to submit a formal application.(attached). The submission has a very high chance of success and is designed as a pilot project of 1 year with a USD500,000 budget ceiling as requested by GMH. If this first phase is successful, there is a high chance of additional multimillion funding (likely at least USD 3M). GMH is a new donor for GGGI Africa with high potential.for future funding. For example, they gave USD10M to the CCAC in 2021 and are also supporting C40 in Africa.They are active at the global level with a focus on methane mitigationThe proposed project is articulated around 1 deliverable in each of 3 countries (Morocco, Senegal, Cote d'Ivoire) as follows:Morocco: development of a government standard for bio-digestate reuse to land to enable the establishment and operation of bio-digesters (linked to the existing GGGI biogas program)Cote d'Ivoire:Support the government in the coordination of ongoing initiatives on the national MRV system and baseline study on waste MRV; Development of an economic model to establish a large scale waste valorization centre with a strong focus on organic waste (this second action is optional and will likely be removed due to budget limitations)Senegal:Identification of an investment project pipeline in the food and agri-processing sectors (two projects shortlisted for pre-feasibility study)These options will be tightened up during budget development, to ensure it can be delivered in a realistic manner.The project will be delivered at country level with existing staff, with coordination from the regional office
